title: Dexcom G6 - No valid timestamp stored for transmitter
symptom: After using the wizard to set up a Dexcom G6 transmitter and sensor, no readings were received after the 2-hour warmup. Stopping and starting the sensor did not help, and eventually the sensor crashed and is now always stopped. The logs repeatedly show the message 'No valid timestamp stored for transmitter:8Gxxxx'.
evidence_quote: If I look at the logs I see severla times the message "No valid timestamp stored for transmitter:8Gxxxx"
